answer: Start from style-consistency proof across epochs. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. A farm running 754 aliases would need 754 separate proofs, each costing about 104 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the falcon here is verification, the marble of cost is what stops the farm, and the mesa of the record keeps every claim checkable. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
